x: Was it when Rushmer "came again" and doubtfully pipped Holt on the finishing line of the 6 miles? Was it when Stewart appeared from nowhere to pass Rix in the final yards of the mile?.
Brian Kilby 52 seconds ahead, Simmons (the Derby No.1) on his heels and another three of the day's top runners, Rushmer, Holt and Jackson chasing hard.
Until a week or so before the selectors met, John was one of only three Britons who had done the Olympic qualifying time for 5,000 metres (the others were Taylor and Rushmer).

This was the occasion when everyone expected the 'terrible three' - Rushmer, Taylor and McCafferty - to clinch their Olympic places. But the latter did not appear and does not seem to be interested in Mexico.

The next instalment of this 'Taylor/Rushmer' type contest is eagerly awaited.
